text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 tests are used to detect current or past SARS-CoV-2 infection. There are two main types: tests that detect the virus itself, and tests that detect antibodies produced in response to infection. Rapid antigen tests, also known as lateral flow tests, are a quick and affordable option for detecting the virus. For those in LA County who are 65+ or unable to leave home, free tests are available.
